svg.text: BAR sizing on 05:00.0 / 04:00.0 — write 0xFFFFFFFF, read back, restore; size = lowest writable bit
lowest set bit = bit 8 → 0x100 (256 B) ✓ (upper 16 bits hardwired 0: I/O space is 64 KiB)
~(m & ~3) + 1 = 0xFFFF0100 ✗ → '~mask + 1' only works when every upper bit is writable
lo mask alone is 0 → "unimplemented" if you test only the low dword ✗
순서: cmd = Command(16-bit) → Command = cmd & ~(IO|MEM) → BAR마다 orig = rd · wr 0xFFFFFFFF · m = rd · wr orig
→ Command = cmd. upper 16 bits(Status)는 0으로 써야 RW1C 에러 비트(예: 05:00.0의 RMA)가 안 지워짐
